use_case: Face verification (1:1) at the county administration building employee entrance: the reader compares a live face image with the enrolled template of the badge presented
business_owner: Security Systems Technician (for the county, which decides on use)
vendor_or_model: Access control vendor face verification add-on (machine-learning face matching) in the SYS-01 tenant, with 2 face-capable readers
build_or_buy: Buy (vendor feature, configured by the company)
data_categories: Face templates (treated as biometric data); enrollment photos; badge credential numbers; match scores; access events
consequential_decision_category: Physical access to a government workplace; physical security of a government facility
human_in_the_loop: Face match is a second factor with the badge. A failed match falls back to badge plus PIN or the guard desk; no one is refused entry on a face result alone; no use for discipline without county human review
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (treated as biometric data under 501.171(1)(g)1.a.(VI) and 501.702; counsel to confirm); Fla. Stat. 119.071(5)(g) (biometric exemption names only fingerprints and friction ridge records) and 119.0701; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor and company claims); county security exhibit; Florida Digital Bill of Rights does not apply (controller test not met)
status: Pilot continues for enrolled volunteers only; no new enrollments; conditions due 2026-10-31

use_case: Machine-learning alarm prioritization in the BAS monitoring service: reorders non-critical alarms by predicted importance
vendor_or_model: BAS monitoring vendor feature (SYS-02), on by default
data_categories: BAS alarm and trend data (no personal data)
consequential_decision_category: None (building operations); critical alarm classes are fixed and cannot be downgraded
human_in_the_loop: Technicians fix the critical alarm classes; on-call technician sees every alarm; monthly review of downgraded alarms
applicable_laws: County and city contract service levels (alarm response); SA-9 vendor oversight
status: In production; accepted with monthly review (P01 R-022)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft reports, emails, or BAS troubleshooting notes
data_categories: Risk of door schedules, point lists, cardholder data, drawings, or CUI being pasted
risk_tier: Low if no customer data is entered; High if Restricted data is entered
human_in_the_loop: Staff review every output before use
applicable_laws: POL-02 C.2 and POL-04 4.7; county security exhibit (confidentiality); 32 CFR Part 2002 for CUI (CT-F)
status: Prohibited for Restricted data; allowed for text with no customer data
